subject.title: Explore Google Photos backup via Takeout or Data Portability API

question: Should gogcli own a narrow Drive-delivered Takeout ingestion workflow, pursue a broader portability command family, or defer complete Google Photos backup until Google exposes a direct supported API?
rationale: The available official interfaces support different portions of the workflow, while complete archive access introduces significant OAuth, sensitive-data, state-management, and long-running-operation commitments that cannot be selected safely from code evidence alone.

options.title: Feasibility first
options.body: Produce a focused API, OAuth, threat-model, and CLI-placement document before authorizing implementation.

options.title: Drive ingestion only
options.body: Authorize only detection, resumable download, integrity verification, and local state tracking for Takeout archives users already deliver to Drive.

options.title: Defer complete backup
options.body: Keep existing partial Photos access and wait for a supported complete-library API before adding backup commands.

recommendation.title: Feasibility first
recommendation.body: Produce a focused API, OAuth, threat-model, and CLI-placement document before authorizing implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses the existing Photos, Drive, backup, OAuth, and overall CLI product boundaries connected to this contributor's current-main work.
